'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals Steve Yaeger DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Yaeger]] at [[2010 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
